pit_safety_argument: The feature reads two backward-looking mean calculations on held-dated-contract open interest (OI), closing window at t-2 to observe OI with one-session provisional-OI delay. Means are computed within economic groups (energy vs energy, grains vs grains) to apply group demeaning. No data reads forward of t-2. All inputs are observed at filing time (exchange publishes OI daily at session close). The ranking and long/short construction are deterministic functions of historical data only. No restated or reforecasted inputs. The feature is point-in-time safe.
duplication_argument_vs_settled_aggregat: Two prior rows in the family POSITIONING|EXCHANGE_OPEN_INTEREST|COMMODITY_FUTURES|XS_LONG_SHORT are settled NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE: (1) H_b5e5e7c0_483c5c1043eb - 'aggregate whole-curve open interest, all listed contract months', (2) H_b5e5e7c0_7f7cdc392f88 - 'front-contract share of whole-curve OI against 12-month norm'. This feature reads HELD-DATED-CONTRACT open interest growth, GROUP-DEMEANED. It is distinct from both: held-contract OI is not whole-curve OI (not a sum across all months), and it is not a ratio of shares. The R60 director ruled held-contract OI distinct from whole-curve when r60_05 was completed under the same family key. This feature applies that ruling to commodities and does not collapse to the settled aggregate. Furthermore, group demeaning ensures the signal is not merely a sector bet (e.g., oil booming while grains collapse). The director explicitly states: 'Held-contract open interest is not whole-curve open interest and is not the front share of it.'
zero_is_missing_rule: Exchange open interest = 0 is MISSING, not zero positioning. The R38 dataset carries 63 provisional newest rows plus 6,664 in-history zeros across 23 markets. When computing the 21-session and 63-session means WITHIN EACH ECONOMIC GROUP, zero OI observations are treated as missing and excluded from the denominator. Any decision-date observation where a market's OI is zero or missing is marked unscorable. If the share of decision-eligible market-sessions carrying usable, non-zero, non-provisional open interest falls below 0.80, the cell halts as DATA_HOLD. A group with fewer than two scorable markets at a decision contributes nothing; single-member groups demean to exactly zero and do not enter the book.

features.name: oi_growth_21_63_mean_ratio_held_contract_group_demeaned
features.formula_plain_english: For each commodity market on the held dated contract: compute the trailing 21-session mean of exchange open interest (sessions ending at t-2), divide by the trailing 63-session mean of exchange open interest (sessions ending at t-2), then DEMEAN WITHIN economic group. (A) Assign each commodity to an economic group (e.g., energy: crude, heating oil, natural gas; grains: corn, wheat, soybeans; precious metals: gold, silver). (B) Compute the group mean of the OI-growth ratio for all scorable markets in that group at that decision. (C) Subtract the group mean from each market's ratio. (D) Rank demeaned ratios. Go SHORT markets with fastest OI growth relative to group (highest demeaned ratio), LONG markets with slowest growth (lowest demeaned ratio), using rank weights. Single-member groups contribute nothing (demean to zero).
contract_legs: held_dated_contract - the contract actually in the book, with real roll dates

inputs.name: exchange_open_interest_held_contract
inputs.description: Exchange-reported open interest for the held dated contract, daily at session close
inputs.lag_rationale: R38 OI is provisional and must be observed with one-session delay. Two sessions ensures the data is revised-safe and the windows do not overlap with the decision instant t.
inputs.source: R38 native dated-contract layer, exchange daily feed
inputs.availability_instant: Session t-1 (next business day after session t closes), revised-safe at session t-2
inputs.data_property: Non-null when exchange records it; zero = missing, not positioning

inputs.name: window_21_session_mean_group
inputs.description: Arithmetic mean of exchange open interest over 21 sessions ending at t-2, computed separately for each economic group
inputs.source: Computed from exchange_open_interest_held_contract, rolling 21-session window, filtered to group members only
inputs.availability_instant: Computable at any t >= 21 sessions after market inception
inputs.exclusion_rule: Excludes zero-is-missing rows; if fewer than 3 non-zero observations in the 21-session window within a group, the group has insufficient data for that window and markets in that group are marked unscorable on that decision

inputs.name: window_63_session_mean_group
inputs.description: Arithmetic mean of exchange open interest over 63 sessions ending at t-2, computed separately for each economic group
inputs.source: Computed from exchange_open_interest_held_contract, rolling 63-session window, filtered to group members only
inputs.availability_instant: Computable at any t >= 63 sessions after market inception
inputs.exclusion_rule: Excludes zero-is-missing rows; if fewer than 10 non-zero observations in the 63-session window within a group, the group has insufficient data and markets in that group are marked unscorable

inputs.name: group_demeaning
inputs.description: For each group, compute the mean OI-growth ratio (21-session mean / 63-session mean) across all scorable markets in that group at decision t. Subtract this group mean from each market's individual ratio.
inputs.source: Computed from individual market ratios and group membership
inputs.rule: A group with only one scorable market at a decision contributes nothing; its single member's demeaned value is zero. A group with zero scorable markets contributes nothing.

features.winsorisation: No explicit winsorisation applied. Ratio clipping is implicit: if numerator or denominator is zero-is-missing, the market is unscorable. Demeaning is linear and unbounded; no secondary clipping to [0,1] or similar.
features.scaling_cross_sectional_treatment: Rank-weighted long/short: each market receives a weight proportional to its rank (1 to N) among scorable markets WITHIN its group after demeaning. Fastest growers (highest demeaned ratio) receive negative weight (SHORT), slowest receive positive weight (LONG). Weights are normalized to sum to zero in absolute value across the book. This is a pure rank scheme with no factor demeaning beyond the declared group demeaning.
features.sparse_column_rule: Open interest columns are dense on major commodity exchanges (most decisions have most markets scorable). If a market's OI is missing on >20% of decisions, the market is excluded from the universe. The flatten-only-scaler rule does not apply here because OI is a real position metric, not a sparse event flag. If OI = 0 (missing), the market is unscorable on that decision and contributes nothing to its group's mean.
leak_conditions: Any forward read of exchange OI after t-2 (would require information not knowable at decision time)
Using aggregate whole-curve open interest instead of held-contract OI (would collapse to settled null H_b5e5e7c0_483c5c1043eb)
Reading revised-retroactive open interest not yet published at t-2 (revisions are incorporated session-by-session)
Omitting group demeaning (would become a sector bet and lose the signal-from-crowding rationale)
Including single-member groups in the rank (they demean to zero and must not enter as spurious neutrals)
Winsorising the zero observations (0 is missing, not an outlier)

pre_registered_halt_conditions: COST_BUDGET: if alpha_agent.r61.cost_budget.evaluate_cost_budget returns COST_BUDGET_EXCEEDED or COST_BUDGET_NOT_EVALUABLE at measured one-way turnover and measured notional-weighted effective per-market rate, halt before any return is scored. Ceiling 0.03/yr.
OPEN_INTEREST_COVERAGE: if usable non-zero, non-provisional OI coverage falls below 0.80 over decision-eligible market-sessions, halt as DATA_HOLD. Floor 0.80 is frozen here.
GROUP_DEMEANING: an economic group with fewer than two scorable markets at a decision contributes nothing. Single-member groups must not enter the book as spurious neutrals.
MIN_MARKETS: if median count of live, scorable markets per decision falls below the FUTURES_DATED_CONTRACT book's declared minimum, the book refuses and the cell settles BOOK_REFUSED.
STAGE_ADVANCE: alpha_agent.r59.engines.stage_advance is sole authority. A halt at D or V settles as recorded.
SIGN: expected_sign -1 is frozen. A result of opposite sign (positive net excess) is a FAILURE.

limitations: The feature reads only the held-dated-contract OI, not the full term structure. Deferred-month OI dynamics are not captured.
No intra-session microstructure; daily close OI only.
One-session OI delay means the feature cannot react to intra-day OI acceleration.
Group demeaning controls for sector effects (oil booming while grains collapse) but does not capture inter-commodity substitution or cross-commodity carry flows.
Ranking is cross-sectional and deterministic; no time-series autoregression.
Economic groups are fixed and pre-declared; adding or removing markets/groups after measurement would change the feature.
Single-member groups contribute nothing; if a group shrinks to one market (e.g., due to delisting or data gaps), that market sits out.
Expected sign is known to be negative (crowding and unwind); positive sign is a falsification.
declared_trigger: Not applicable; this is a rank-weighted long/short book. It trades every decision.
leakage_check: PASS. All inputs are backward-looking historical means. Windows close at t-2. Group demeaning is a deterministic calculation from data at or before t-2. No forward data. No unobservable restated revisions. No conditioning on future information. The feature is locked in before the decision at t.
pit_availability_rule: R38 OI revised-safe at session t-2; no PIT revisions are observed later.
missingness_rule: exchange_open_interest_held_contract = 0 is MISSING. Handled explicitly: (1) zero rows are excluded from mean calculations within each group; (2) markets with zero OI are marked unscorable; (3) groups with fewer than the minimum necessary observations to compute a mean become unscorable; (4) single-member groups demean to zero and do not enter the book.
revision_behavior: R38 OI is provisional at publication (session t-1) and revised at session t-2. The feature reading at t-2 observes the revised OI; no future revisions affect it.
director_recorded_statement: Two measured siblings are null. A fourth charged slot in a family that has twice said nothing is close to the definition of waste. Running anyway because: (1) It is the last unmeasured member of a family already paid three burden slots for; (2) reopen condition explicitly written by R60 director; (3) repair is test-pinned; (4) it is the cheapest of three to run to a halt; (5) ordered LAST in review_order so it pays largest denominator. If it fails, close this family.
